items.title: Private AI Infrastructure
items.cardLine: On-premises, managed private, or hybrid compute for your models and data.
items.heroLine: Dedicated compute placement deciding data location, connectivity, control, and operational responsibility.
items.summary: Choose where inference and data live: on-premises, managed private infrastructure, or hybrid.
items.lede: AI services need somewhere to run. JSI designs that foundation so models, retrieval, and workflows have a known home.

sections.heading: Three placement patterns
bullets: On-premises: equipment in your campus room. You control physical access and power.
Managed private: dedicated capacity operated with JSI under an agreed site access list.
Hybrid: retrieval stays local; named external services handle burst inference.

paragraphs: Sizing starts from concurrent sessions, context length, embedding dimension, and GPU requirements. Connectivity models include air-gapped, allow-listed egress, or hybrid connectors.
Operational responsibility is split in writing: OS patching, key rotation, retrieval index disk monitoring, and n8n retry escalation.

items.title: Local LLM Solutions
items.cardLine: Hosted language models for assistants and APIs, matched to your hardware.
items.heroLine: Local inference serving assistants, APIs, and workflows without public data exposure.
items.summary: Hosted language models for assistants, inference APIs, and business applications.
items.lede: A local model is a program running on compute you name. It drafts, classifies, and extracts.

sections.heading: Selection & operation
bullets: Model selection: parameter size, context window, and license terms matching hardware.
Deployment: serving stack, version pinning, and rollback paths for weight files.
Integration: documented internal APIs for apps and n8n automation.

paragraphs: Model selection balances VRAM and context limits. Optional cloud fallbacks are explicit and named—failed local inference never silently exports prompts.

items.title: RAG and Enterprise Knowledge
items.cardLine: Answers grounded in approved files with source citations and refusal rules.
items.heroLine: Retrieval-augmented generation grounding model answers in verified organizational documents.
items.summary: Answers grounded in approved files with source citations or insufficient evidence warnings.
items.lede: RAG retrieves passages from approved files before drafting. The model speaks; files provide the brief.

sections.heading: Grounded retrieval journey
bullets: Ingestion: split documents into passages tagged with source and permissions.
Retrieval: query pulls permitted passages, never unapproved files.
Citations: answers cite source passages or state insufficient evidence.

paragraphs: Chunking, embedding, and access-aware filters are configured per domain. Evaluation cases test citation accuracy and refusal thresholds.

items.title: Local Agentic Workflows
items.cardLine: Self-hosted n8n automation with local LLMs, deterministic rules, and human approval.
items.heroLine: Deterministic agentic sequences connecting local models with business actions and approval checkpoints.
items.summary: Self-hosted n8n connected to local models and RAG with rules and human checkpoints.
items.lede: An agentic workflow interprets, looks up, checks, waits, and acts under explicit rules.

sections.heading: Operable automation
bullets: Run history: complete log of starts, inputs, and outputs.
Retries & limits: transient errors retry with explicit failure bounds.
Approval checkpoints: human review required before creating tasks or side effects.

paragraphs: n8n runs self-hosted next to models. Connectors to external services (email, APIs) are explicitly configured and credentialed via secure vaults.

items.title: SWAN Intelligent Smart Boards
items.cardLine: Interactive smart boards for classrooms and meetings, with proposed AI features.
items.heroLine: Intelligent interactive displays for teaching, collaboration, and grounded classroom AI assistance.
items.summary: SWAN panels are JSI's registered interactive display brand for teaching and meeting rooms.
items.lede: SWAN boards are the physical interface for classrooms and meeting rooms to interact with local AI.

sections.heading: Classroom & meeting interface
bullets: Hardware: 65", 75", and 86" class 4K UHD touch panels with Android & OPS Windows.
Proposed AI: lesson material Q&A, quiz drafting, and meeting note assistance.
Procurement: available for purchase or rental with installation and support.

paragraphs: The board functions as an endpoint connecting to campus APIs. Specifications (OPS module, touch points, OS) are confirmed per quotation.

items.title: Deployment and Operations
items.cardLine: Scoped path: Discover, Design, Pilot, Deploy, and Operate your private AI.
items.heroLine: Structured deployment journey with defined sizing, evaluation, security, and ongoing support.
items.summary: A structured engagement model: Discover → Design → Pilot → Deploy → Operate.
items.lede: JSI guides organizations through scoped deployment with clear operational boundaries.

sections.heading: 5-Step deployment journey
bullets: Discover: map rooms, documents, identity, and privacy boundaries.
Design: select placement, model sizes, and retrieval scope.
Pilot: validate single workflow or classroom before full rollout.
Deploy & Operate: establish monitoring, maintenance, and support runbooks.

paragraphs: Security baselines, maintenance windows, and support SLAs are defined in engagement contracts.
